initial.name: needs-you-desktop
initial.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity COMPLETE desktop MCP App screen, a restrained workroom UI called dap, embedded in an AI chat host. This is a design reference, not a marketing page. Canvas landscape about1536x1024, straight-on crisp browser-quality interface only, no device frame, no browser chrome, no host logos or chat messages. Use supplied image ONLY as the existing dap wordmark reference, faithfully at72px width in header. Palette exact: bone #F3F1EA canvas, white #FFFFFF occasional controls, forest #123F2B actions/links, ink #16180F text, muted #6B6A5F, lines #D8D5CB; garnet #7A1F2E only refusals. Rounded humanist sans like Open Runde, headings32px/600, body16px/24, metadata13px monospaced. Sharp zero-radius surfaces, square buttons with a subtle45degree cut bottom-right, no shadows/gradients. 8px spacing scale, generous40px gutters, centered content max1100px. Header: actual small dap logo atleft, 'Task list' room name beside it; right explicit actor 'Ari · person'. Thin divider; simple textual two-item nav 'Needs you' active green underline and 'Work'. Main heading 'Needs you'. Catch-up band contains '7 new entries since your last review', 'Through entry248', outlined 'Mark reviewed' action, helper 'Reading an item leaves its work open.' Main content is an OPEN LIST of exactly3 generously spaced horizontal rows, separated by thin rules, not cards or a cardgrid. Each row shows a bold title, actor role/controller, three compact labelled explanations 'What needs you', 'Why you', 'What settles it', and one clear right-aligned link-button. Row1 title 'Keep completed tasks in history?'; actor square agent mark with text 'Storage agent · agent' and 'Controlled by Ari'; what 'A product decision is waiting.'; why 'You were asked to approve text v2.'; settles 'Review the alternatives and record your choice.'; action 'Read decision'. Row2 title 'Clear completed · version2'; actor 'Interface agent · agent' and 'Controlled by Ari'; what 'A change is ready for review.'; why 'Your review is requested.'; settles 'Review this version before merging.'; action 'Review change'. Row3 title 'Publication outcome unknown'; actor circular person mark with 'Ari · person'; what 'The merge reply did not arrive.'; why 'You sent the original request.'; settles 'Check that request’s outcome.'; action 'Check outcome'. Footer '3 items shown · 1 scope checked'. Make people and agents visually distinct with words and simple circle/person versus square/agent geometric markers, never color alone; no avatars/photos. There are no approve/merge controls on this screen. Preserve exact workflow, no new product areas, fake analytics, decorative pills, hero eyebrows, illustrations, dashboardsidebar, cardgrid, or extra inventedcopy. Clear, airy, legible, senior product-design execution. Every text/control must be practicable as code-native HTML/CSS later; do not make any interface a rasterasset in implementation. This is the first reference of a coordinated five-family desktop/mobile light/dark set; lock this visual system.
